Siegemaster Fezzik is the goblin in charge of preparing the Argent Vanguard to withstand Scourge attacks.

Siegebreaker Battlegear set is the Tier 8 damage warrior raid set. It is composed of any items from these sub-sets: *Valorous Siegebreaker Battlegear - from armor tokens gained in 10-man Ulduar raids *Conqueror's Siegebreaker Battlegear - from armor tokens gained in 25-man Ulduar raids
__NOTOC__ Shurrak is an orc stable master located in the Tenebrous Cavern in the Abyssal Depths.

Siege of Wyrmrest Temple is a Cataclysm raid achievement awarded for defeating the first four bosses of Dragon Soul. This achievement is required for queueing for the second half of Dragon Soul in Raid Finder: the Fall of Deathwing.
Sides of Bear Meat drop from Shaggy Black Bears in the Western Plaguelands.
Shu-Li Spadepaw is a pandaren located at Stoneplow Fields in the Valley of the Four Winds. When the mantid attacked, she was wounded, but Feng and Dawnchaser tauren protected her.
Shuk'sar is a talbuk who was used by Thrall as his mount during his trip in Nagrand. He was described as a mount suitable for novices.

Sigdis the Trader is a frost vrykul general goods vendor located at Brunnhildar Village in Storm Peaks.
The Shroud of Winter's Chill can be found inside the Ice Chest after defeating Lord Ahune in the Slave Pens.
Siege of Orgrimmar Guild Run is an achievement that is awarded for defeating all bosses in the Siege of Orgrimmar raid instance while in a guild group.
Shroud of the Celestials - Guild Edition is a guild achievement for having a member with Shroud of the Celestials.
Siege of Niuzao Temple Challenger is an achievement earned for completing the Siege of Niuzao Temple challenge mode.

__NOTOC__ Siegecrafter's Forge Hammer drops from Siegecrafter Blackfuse in the Siege of Orgrimmar.
Siege Engineers are Mag'har orcs found in The Inner Sanctum during the Siege of Orgrimmar. They take part in the Garrosh Hellscream encounter.
The Siegeworks is a large elaborate machine dedicated for the creation of Iron Juggernauts. This foundry is found deep within the Underhold connected by the Underhold Nexus.
Sickly Refugees were humans once found at the Greymane Wall in Silverpine Forest.

Shui Halad, also known as the Sleeper, is a bone worm that can be found in the Sleeper's Lair in northwestern Frostfire Ridge. She slumbered underground for a generation—until a group of pale orcs recently awakened her. Shui Halad began to thrash violently, causing earthquakes in the area, and her young came to the surface and attacked the local wildlife. The Horde commander was forced to kill her.
Shy Sheng is a pandaren child located at the Temple of the Jade Serpent in the Jade Forest. She is walking around with Chunhua the Spinning Blossom.
Siege-o-Matic 4000 is a gnomish copter located on The Skyfire in Krasarang Wilds.

The Siege of Orgrimmar trailer is the official trailer for World of Warcraft Patch 5.4: Siege of Orgrimmar. The trailer shows Garrosh retrieving the Heart of Y'Shaarj and the fight bewteen the Warchief of the Horde and the leader of Shado-Pan.
Siege of Vanguard is the tenth mission of the Alliance campaign in Warcraft II: Beyond the Dark Portal.

The siege of Bladespire Citadel was a battle between the Frostwolf Orcs and Horde forces led by and , and the Bladespire clan of ogres. The orcs, wishing to gain a foothold against the encroaching ogres and Iron Horde, Ga'nar led the charge against them to gain a strategic position to command Frostfire Ridge. After Durotan and Thrall brought up the rear, they freed the slaves of the ogres and killed the ogre lord in Last Steps.
The Sigil-Stitched Drape drops from Kormrok in on Raid Finder mode.
Siegecrafter Elaani is a draenei located at in Talador. She builds ballistae. Nearby her, the crystalline spear projectiles are being crafted.
Sidney Splattervalve is a goblin vendor located at the Pinchwhistle Gearworks in Spires of Arak.

Si'vash is a naga in Broken Shore. She is one of four Broken Shore world bosses that have a chance to become available to players while the Nether Disruptor building is active.
Sifting Through the Sand is an archaeology achievement earned from completing 100 dig sites on the Broken Isles.
Sigil of Awakening is obtained by defeating the echo of Archimonde in the Praetorium in Eredath.
Si'vashi Honor Guards are naga located Strand's End on the Broken Shore. They accompany Si'vash.

Siege Engine Cannons are cannons located in the Arathi Highlands during the Battle for Stromgarde.
Siegeworks Technicians are orcs located in the Iron Bulwark in .

Shuck 'n Cuts - Seaside Smokery is a food shop selling fish-based meals at Anglepoint Wharf in Tiragarde Sound. The place is run by Chef Clark.
Shuurt the Clothripper is a furbolg located just south of Grizzlemaw in the Grizzly Hills. He provides the Shuurt's Precious for free.

Shuurt's Precious is provided for free by Shuurt the Clothripper just south of Grizzlemaw in the Grizzly Hills during Free T-Shirt Day. The rest of the year, it can be purchased for from Skin-Me-Own-Coat Dibblefur in Booty Bay.

The Shrouded Hollow is a cave in the southeastern end of the Abandoned Burrows in Vol'dun. After crashing into the Brine Basin, the Horde adventurer awoke as a Faithless captive in the Shrouded Hollow before being rescued by Nisha.

The Shrouded Shore is a short stretch of coastline east and northeast of the Terrace of the Fang in northern Vol'dun. Starting just north of the Whispering Crag and Darkwood Shoal, it continues past the Terrace of the Fang before ending near the northernmost part of the coast, which is instead considered part of the Whispering Crag.
Shu the Inscrutable is a pandaren seller on the Black Market Auction House.
The Shroud of Unmooring Whispers drops from Za'qul in the Eternal Palace.

__NOTOC__ Siegeing Sentinels are night elf archers attacking the Necropolis in Nazmir alongside the Overgrown Ancient while the Faction Assault on Nazmir world quest Overgrown Ancient (quest) is available. They also appear in Vol'dun.
Shui Huzin is a pandaren located in Brawl'gar Arena and Bizmo's Brawlpub as part of the Battle of the Brew encounter.
Siege of Dazar'alor is a dungeon & raids achievement earned by defeating defeating Champion of the Light, Grong the Revenant and Jadefire Masters in the Battle of Dazar'alor.

The Shrouded Asylum is an area located in the western border of the Ember Ward, with Dawnkeep to the north and Cinderwall to the south and southeast. There is a mirror along the southeastern edge that connects this area with the Sanctuary of the Mad's crypt. Within the Shoruded Asylum one sees stoneborn loyal to Denathrius fighting with the Shrouded; Lost Sybille implies that the venthyr of the asylum turned on Denathrius when the Light invaded the Ember Ward. The venthyr here are being infiltrated by venthyr loyal to Prince Renathal. The Anima Conductor in Sinfall is able to unlock a daily buff in this area.
The Shrouded Cloth Bag is created with Shadowlands Tailoring (15); taught by Stitcher Au'phes in Oribos.

__NOTOC__ The Sight-O-Matic 3001 is a telescope located atop a small peak to the north of Sindragosa's Fall in Icecrown. Fizzix Blastbolt has set it up to spy on Mord'rethar: The Death Gate. According to Fizzix, it's "the best, furthest reaching surveillance device this side of the snow." Looking through it will offer a closer look at the grounds near Mor'drethar, revealing a number of plague eruptors and wagon-mounted plague cauldrons.

Shrouded Hand Towels are created with Shadowlands Tailoring (5); taught by Pattern: Shrouded Hand Towel.
Sicklethorn is one of the spriggan groups of Ardenweald. They are found in the Garden of Night.
Shroud of Winter is a Frost death knight PvP talent, available at level 50.

The Shrouded are a group of venthyr in Revendreth, serving Denathrius. They controlled the areas of the Shrouded Asylum shaded from the Light, had stores of anima in the compound, and patrolled the Ember Ward. They had fragments of mirror glass used for making traps. They were later infiltrated by forces of Prince Renathal.
Shrouded Necromancers are Maldraxxi necromancers located in the Ember Court.
Siege Engineer's Waistband is a quest reward from A Pilot's Revenge.

Shroud of the Sire's Chosen drops from the Lords of Dread in the Sepulcher of the First Ones.
__NOTOC__ Shrouded Cypher Caches are found throughout Zereth Mortis.
Sickleshanks is a spriggan who attacks Thiernax in the Garden of Night in Ardenweald. With his dying breath, he curses Qadarin.
Shurom is a centaur leatherworking trainer located at Timberstep Outpost in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

Siege on Dragonbane Keep: Snack Attack is an exploration achievement earned during stage 1 of the scenario Siege on Dragonbane Keep by feeding 20 Beef Snacks to Beef while he's towing the cart north to the keep.
Siege on Dragonbane Keep: Home Sweet Home is an exploration achievement earned by completing the Siege on Dragonbane Keep scenario. See the Siege article for more information.

Siege on Dragonbane Keep: Chiseled Record is an exploration achievement earned in Dragonbane Keep, by finding all of the djaradin tablets. They are: *Complaint to Scalepiercer at (inside Scalepiercer's Hut in the back-left) *The Grand Flame's Journal at (north of the main keep) *Wyrmeater's Recipe at (inside Wyrmeater's southern hut behind the left door jamb) Note that the Siege on Dragonbane Keep does not need to be active to find these objects. Si'va is a jungle troll located on the Defiant Dragonscale in Durotar.

Sidra the Mender is a green dragon in night elf form found healing Vermera in the northern part of the Shady Sanctuary in the Ohn'ahran Plains. On Merithra's orders, she states that she and her sisters will join the battle at the Storm Scar to care for the wounded. However, she is not seen participating in the battle, instead disappearing sometime after completion of the quest Shady Sanctuary (quest). __NOTOC__
Siaszerathel is a dracthyr located in the Caldera of the Menders in the Forbidden Reach, tending to a Soar Enhancer. She later appears in Thaldraszus as a member of the Timewalkers.

Siege on Dragonbane Keep is an event taking place in the Waking Shores, available after reaching Renown Level 5 with the Valdrakken Accord. It involves the Obsidian Outcasts attacking the djaradin and their forces at the Dragonbane Keep, retaking their home. Occuring every second hour, the event is denoted by the Siege on Dragonbane map icon: :The Outcasts will begin their siege soon! Its inactivity is denoted by: :The siege is over, and the keep is controlled by the Obsidian Outcasts.

__NOTOC__ Shukoro Rapidstamer is a tauren located at Froststone Vault in the Forbidden Reach. She is part of the frost variant of Froststone Vault Primal Storm as the last obstacle.
Sibella is a dryad herbalism trainer located in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
Sidereal Essence drops from the final boss in Titan Rune Dungeons with Defense Protocol Beta activated.
Shy Melvin drops from the Deadly Dapperling at Glutharn's Decay in Maldraxxus.
Shuffling Sands is sold by Usodormu at the Temporal Conflux in Thaldraszus for .
Sideboat is sold by Tuktu at Khalla and Tuktu's grill in the Ohn'ahran Plains for .
Sickly Egg Sacs is contained in Disturbed Dirt, Decay Covered Chest, and Expedition Scout's Pack.
Shroud of Raging Tempests is sold by Mythressa for and Rethelshi in Valdrakken for .

Silithus (also known as the Silithus Desert) forms the southwestern corner of Kalimdor. It can only be reached on foot by traveling to the northwestern corner of Un'Goro Crater, where a wide path extends out of the crater and into Silithus. Silithus is one of the insect infested sections of southern Kalimdor. This area houses a section of the once great Aqiri empire, known as Ahn'Qiraj. It is currently uninhabited, but the central temple is sealed off by the night elves, who attempted to prevent an infestation from breaking out. They were unsuccessful in their attempt to seal them behind the Scarab Wall and over the millennia the Silithid spread hives from Silithus to as far as Feralas. The
The silithid are an insectoid race created by C'Thun and found primarily in Kalimdor. Unlike the qiraji, the silithid are non-sentient, though they remain dangerous foes.

Silithid larvae, also known as broodlings, are young silithid that as of yet been specialized for any role in the hive. Eventually the broodling encases itself in a cocoon and changes into its new form, such as a wasp, reaver, swarmer, or possibly any type of silithid found useful to the hive.
.]] The silithid worker is the worker caste of the silithid. They are generally not aggressive unless they or other nearby silithid are attacked. They will attempt to run when they have low health.
Silithid scarabs are part of a caste of the silithid. Often found in and outside the hives. Many of these silithid are not aggressive unless they or another nearby silithid is attacked.
Silithid pill bugs are part of a caste of the silithid. They are very similar to the Silithid lights.

The Silithid Royalty, also known as the Trinity, the Triumvirate, the Triad, the Bug Family, the Three Bugs, and the Royal Trio, is an optional boss encounter in the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj. It is composed of , and , which must be fought all at the same time.
Sildanair is a night elf warrior trainer located in the Warrior's Terrace in Darnassus. It is unknown whether she survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.
Signet of the Unseen Path is part of the Trappings of the Unseen Path set.
Silithid Carapace Chestguard is plate chest armor with a large amount of nature resistance.

.]] Silent Fang is a Main Hand Sword that drops from Darkmaster Gandling in Scholomance. It has an estimated proc chance of 5% to silence the enemy for 6 seconds - because of that, it is a somewhat handy weapons for Rogues who often have the task of silencing casters. The high speed of the weapon might also make it useful for fury Warriors.
Silithus Venom Samples drop from the following mobs in Silithus: *Stonelash Flayer *Rock Stalker *Sand Skitterer *Stonelash Scorpid *Stonelash Pincer
Signet of Beckoning: Fire is created by combining the following items: * 1 Scroll: Create Signet of Beckoning (fire) * 1 Dark Rune * 5 Firebloom It is used to summon Abyssal Dukes.
Silithid Carapace Fragments can be looted from silithids in Silithus. You must have Agent of Nozdormu in your bag to loot them.
Signet of the Fallen Defender drops from Instructor Razuvious in Naxxramas.
__NOTOC__ Sikwa is a tauren stable master located at the Crossroads in the Northern Barrens. She defended the town during the Legion Invasions. She was accompanied by two wolves.

Silithyst is "strange red crystalline dust" that appears in the Silithus desert, which both the Horde and the Alliance would like to assemble in quantities as large as possible for researching purposes. Doing just that is the objective of the world PvP event "The Silithyst Must Flow" and the world quest Silithyst (quest), available during the Call of the Scarab micro-holiday. Collecting Silithyst will result in a debuff that slows the character's speed considerably.
Silithid Grubs are silithid larvae found in the Barrens. They are hatched from Silithid Creeper Egg‎s laid by Silithid Creepers.
Sigrun Ironhew is a dwarf quest giver located in a small camp south of Hammertoe's Digsite in the Badlands. He is the apprentice of Feranor Steeltoe.
__NOTOC__ The Silithid Harvester is a rare silithid scarab found outside Desolation Hold in the Southern Barrens.
Silithid Ravagers are silithid reaver found at Sunken Dig Site in the Thousand Needles.

Silithid Protectors are silithid found in the Barrens. Like Silithid Creepers and Silithid Swarmers, these are tameable beasts, not untameable silithid uncategorized creatures. The Sigil of Krasus was a great boon to the Alliance during their battle against the orcs while on the Alliance Expedition. It was held by Archmage Vargoth, but was taken from him when he was imprisoned in the Violet Tower by Kael'thas Sunstrider. The sigil was given to Spellbinder Maryana, a lieutenant of Kael'thas based at Manaforge Coruu.

Silithid Goo is contained in Hive'Ashi Pod in Silithus, this item can be thrown away immediately after looting to save bag space. It has no use, and is only to throw you off track of the real objective for the Hive in the Tower quest (the loot off of one of the Hive'Ashi Ambushers).

Silithus is a contested level 55-60 zone in southwestern Kalimdor. Most of the story is revolving around the rising activity of the silithid and the Twilight's Hammer in the area, and will lead adventurers that arrive to Cenarion Hold to deal with these threats. Unlike most other old world zones, Silithus was not revamped in Cataclysm and has relatively few quests, especially compared to the other level 55-60 zone, Blasted Lands. For this reason, the area provides easy acces to Blasted Lands. The progression of the storyline is tracked in the achievement Silithus Quests.
Silithid Flayers are silithid located in Thousand Needles that spawn during the opening of the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj event.

Sigil of Ignaeus is provided by Zengu for Trol'kalar (Classic) to break the warnings on Trollbane's Tomb. It was formed by merging the Sigil of Strom, Sigil of Thoradin, Sigil of Arathor, and Sigil of Trollbane. When used, it was consumed in a flash of light, and the legendary sword Trol'kalar was released from the stone hands' grip.

Silithyst Geysers can be found throughout Silithus. Picking one up will give you the Silithyst debuff, which will force one to travel at normal speeds no matter what. It will also flag the player for PvP. Should players drop the dust, a Silithyst Mound will spawn at that location, which can then be picked up by any other player.
